scope: Y input information ablation, four bidirectional Transformer predictors
checkpoint_selection: minimum predictor_dev mean factor-balanced relative A/B MSE; every epoch
downstream_selection: highest mean accuracy_dev256 correct count at fixed primary step across the three paired replicates; ties lexicographically by aux name
test_policy: All four variants and all three predefined steps evaluated; no test-based reselection. Reused existing benchmark, not a newly unseen dataset.
replicate_policy: Three paired training/update seed combinations, identical across features. Not a full crossed design; cannot separately estimate training and update seed variance.
extra_features: log RMS and padding validity always present; none means no explicit supervision mask or position features
raw_gradient_definition: Unclipped complete LoRA A/B gradients reconstructed from predicted G; separately report dense G^T X. No direct parameter-gradient prediction head.
